_source: Remaster decisions, not extracted data. Applied to overworld.json at load (GameDataRepository.LoadOverworld) and to the Amiga map pictures (tools/scripts/extract_amiga_map_graphics.py).
_note: tile = the visible tile id; a fogged cell keeps its fog (+120).

overworld.why: D-060 (user s53, manual): APPLETON's town record points at this cell, but DOS has an inn tile (41) here, so the town could not be walked into.
D-060 (user s53/s54): the inn that sat on APPLETON's cell moves here, on the path beside the OUT13 dungeon entrance (3,14).
